classification_rationale: Under the exact corrected RQ-C3 A04 fixture, fully assembled natively (Doubling Season + Hardened Scales on battlefield, Serpent X=3 announced by value and paid, spell resolved), the engine never called chooseSingleReplacementEffect (zero CALLED milestones in 1282 frames) and emitted no replacement_effect frame. possibleReplacers was empty (or the AddCounter event never ran for the ETB counters), so Forge determined ZERO applicable replacement effects and offered no player-discretionary ordering choice. No counter/regen proxy shape was reused; no order was injected.

engine_change_packet_smallest_not_applie.caveat: Causes (a) and (b) are stacked in this shape: base placement yields zero, so layer (b) is untested here. The packet addresses both layers in dependency order; single-predicate isolation of (a) belongs to Forge-remediation scope (RQ-C2), not WS55R.
engine_change_packet_smallest_not_applie.change_b: Route the ETB CounterMap through the AddCounter replacement run: in the GameAction moveToPlay path (GameAction.java:561), run ReplacementType.AddCounter over the entering permanent's ETB counter table with the entering permanent's controller as decider (mirroring the non-ETB GameEntityCounterTable.replaceCounterEffect path), guarding against double-application with the card's own Moved etbCounter replacement (hasRun/Updated bookkeeping already exists in ReplacementHandler.run). The existing chooseSingleReplacementEffect call (ReplacementHandler.java:220, layer Other, both DS+HS match) then yields the authoritative 2-order offer with no provider work.
engine_change_packet_smallest_not_applie.change_a: Fix base etbCounter materialization so X paid (xPaid) materializes as X counters in the ETB CounterMap (paid X=3 observed, placed 0; inner cause not isolated read-only).
engine_change_packet_smallest_not_applie.forge_readonly: No engine edit performed. No pin change. Packet is specification for Forge-remediation/RQ-C2 scope.
engine_change_packet_smallest_not_applie.problem: Serpent ETB counters never become applicable AddCounter replacements: (a) base placement yields zero despite X=3 paid (Moved etbCounter replacement did not materialize; EG-2/EBO-1); (b) even with counters, the ETB CounterMap path (GameAction.java:561, etb=true) skips the ReplacementType.AddCounter run and the Moved event only gathers Moved-type replacements, so AddCounter-type DS/HS never match the entry event.
